derivation: or אַחֲלֵי; prob from H253 (אָח) and a variation of H3863 (לוּא);

occurrences.text: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
